messages:
Maya CSM: heads up — HorizonTech usage dropped ~58% this week vs last. saw ~40% fewer generate/embedding calls per seat :eyes:
Jonas AM: ugh. is this across all teams or specific workspace?
Maya CSM: mostly their 'Search' workspace. top 5 power users down to almost zero. procurement flagged vendor shortlist yesterday.
Leah Eng: any error spikes or auth issues? i can check runtime and KV cache misses.
Maya CSM: no errors, auth looks fine. running a quick query now, pasted below.
Maya CSM: ```sql
select date_trunc('day', ts) as d, count(*) as calls
from usage.events
where account_id='acct_horizon_01'
group by 1
order by 1 desc
limit 14;
```
Jonas AM: can you export last 30d as csv and drop in the ticket? procurement wants numbers to compare vendors.
Anika Solutions: looping in Solutions to offer an enablement refresh / playbook for their Search team — @Maya CSM can we get their top 10 prompts and recent templates? :calendar:
Maya CSM: sharing prompts now, attaching in ticket. adding Leah + Diego to the invite.
ops-bot: Created event 'HorizonTech: Renewal health sync' Thu 10:00-10:30 PT. Invite: https://calendar/evt/abc123
Diego: i'll prepare a 1-page ROI + recommended playbook for the new PM. i'll also capture usage baselines for the pilot.
Leah Eng: i'll validate whether they moved to a lower-precision quantized model or disabled caching. will check infra config and latency tables.
Jonas AM: procurement asked who they're evaluating — do we know vendor names?
Maya CSM: they mentioned VendorX and an in-house monorepo solution. procurement asked about on-prem options and TCO.
Anika Solutions: propose a 2-week Dedicated pilot with setup credit + onboarding for Search team. include success metrics and a quick enablement session for the new PM.
Jonas AM: yes — pilot proposal should include metrics: avg query latency <200ms and usage rebound >=50% within 2 weeks. also include seats and ARR impact estimate.
Diego: action list: Maya — csv + top 10 prompts + last eval notes (champion: Priya K.). Leah — infra config check and KV cache heatmap. Anika — draft pilot scope and runbook. Jonas — reach out to procurement contact and send commercial outline. i'll update the renewal playbook with these tasks.
Maya CSM: done — csv uploaded to the ticket and prompts attached. flagging that the PM switched last week, may explain drop.
Anika Solutions: good. if pilot doesn't restore activity, escalate to SalesOps for Dedicated pricing and extended support.
Jonas AM: pinged procurement contact, they want the pilot doc by EOD tomorrow.
Maya CSM: i'll draft the pilot proposal and share in the thread tonight. thanks team.
Diego: thanks — will bring monitoring dashboard and sample queries to the call.
Maya CSM: keeping thread updated.
file_notes: renewal risk triage for HorizonTech: usage drop concentrated in Search workspace, stakeholder change (new PM), procurement competitive shortlist. actions: pilot proposal, infra check, enablement, CSV export, renewal playbook updates.
